A distinct optional-Int64 division hypothesis has passed the bounded full-Endpoint compiler/native-code screen. The original 32-bit fallback and strict stock builder remain unchanged. The private candidate widens the normalized mantissa before shifting, computes one exact unsigned64 quotient, and preserves sticky rounding through quotient-times-denominator inequality. This is source reasoning plus a compiler/native-code screen, without an arithmetic-equivalence or speed verdict.
